probe.text_sample: Your Page Title Go to homepage Integrations Customers Pricing Blog Overview Buy Spaziobianco Integrations Customers Pricing Blog Overview Buy Spaziobianco Your customers' money, held to bank standards. Funds sit with our partner banks, every request is encrypted and signed, and independent auditors check our controls every year. How we protect every transaction The same controls run behind every account, card and transfer, on every plan. Encryption everywhere TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest, with keys held in hardware security modules. Signed requests Every API call and webhook is signed, so you can verify it came from us and was not changed. Scoped access Role based dashboard access, single sign-on and API keys limited to the actions they need. Fraud monitoring Real-time rules and models score every transfer and card authorization before it settles. Segregated funds Customer balances are held in FDIC insured accounts at partner banks, never on our balance sheet. Audit logs Every action in the dashboard and the API is logged and kept for seven years. Redundant infrastructure Active in multiple regions with automatic failover and a 99.99% uptime target. Responsible disclosure
